title: Austin's Confidential Land & Litigation
summary:
*   City officials convened a special closed-door meeting to discuss legal and property matters without public input.
*   Discussions included two specific, ongoing lawsuits against the city.
*   The agenda featured talks about potential land acquisitions: 3.19 acres near West First Street and the Central Austin Medical Complex.
*   This executive session was for discussion only, and no public actions or final decisions were made.

litigation and personnel matters. No final action will be taken on any subject or matter
unless specifically listed on the agenda for this meeting.
